omlx.name: OMLX
omlx.notes: Model, context, max-tokens and reasoning are applied PER MODEL from ~/.omlx/model_settings.json at request time. Reasoning is task-type driven (top-level 'reasoning': low for standard tasks, medium for LONG) — the benchmark rewrites the model entry's chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort before start and restores it after the run. MTP speculative decoding is ON via the embedded mlx-vlm engine.

mtplx.name: MTPLX
mtplx.notes: All parameters are CLI flags applied at server start. --reasoning-effort is task-type driven (top-level 'reasoning': low for standard tasks, medium for LONG) via the {reasoning} placeholder. Models load from ~/.mtplx/models by repo id ({repo}); the served model id is normalized and auto-adopted. Pick a model in the Model panel. Performance note (from mtplx status): the turbo profile's compiled MTP-verify only applies to sequences ≤ 32768 tokens — LONG-task cells whose context grows past that fall back to eager verification.

mlxvlm.name: MLX-VLM
mlxvlm.notes: mlx_vlm.server with MTP speculative decoding: the MTP-8bit draft pairs with the Youssofal-Quality weights (identical architecture to the dense 8bit - verified tensor-by-tensor in run 20260926-181100: 6/6 cells, QA 100, 19-38 tok/s). Reasoning maps to --enable-thinking; thinking_budget is hard-blocked by mlx_vlm while the draft is loaded, so no budget flags. No ctx flag — serves the model's native context (adopted at start). Per-request metrics from its JSON /metrics.

mlxserve.name: MLX-Serve
mlxserve.notes: vLLM-compatible server with the richest metrics surface (Prometheus /metrics). Reasoning is task-type driven (top-level 'reasoning'): {reasoning} expands to --reasoning-budget <n> (1024 low / 4096 medium). PLD speculative decoding is on by default.

vllm.name: vLLM
vllm.notes: vLLM (dev 0.31, vllm-metal) on macOS serves standard HF repos — NOT MLX builds; Qwen MTP unsupported upstream so far. Reference model: google/gemma-4-31B-it. --enable-auto-tool-choice + --tool-call-parser gemma4 are REQUIRED: pi/opencode send tool_choice=auto and vLLM 400s without them (observed as empty-response/no-output rows).
